label: Recall rate
type: the percentage of true nearest neighbours an approximate vector query returns - the accuracy quantity every vector-index setting is tuned against
note: The object of three tradesOffAgainst relations, from two different subjects (nProbes and reranking), which is what earns it a record: it is the thing the settings are traded against, not a setting itself. NOTABLE ABSENCE: queries per second is the other side of every one of those quotes - 'it caused a linear decrease in QPS', 'it always decreases queries per second (QPS) when enabled' - and the corpus has never minted it. The vector tuning story has three quantities (recall, QPS, memory footprint) and the ontology holds two.
relates_to_competency_question: What can I tune on a vector index, and what does it cost?
